items.title: Molecular Breeding Assistant: Post-Transformation Pipeline & Phenotyping- China Agriculture University
items.detail: • High-Throughput Data Acquisition: Spearheaded downstream phenotypic data collection for CRISPR-edited corn and soybean lines; integrated image-based seed analytics and automated counting systems to digitize agronomic traits and accelerate stock logging. • Pipeline Optimization & QC: Managed the high-stakes transition of gene-edited T0 plantlets from in vitro tissue culture to controlled soil environments; optimized cultivation protocols to achieve a 86% survival and regeneration rate. • Genomic Lineage Tracking: Maintained 100% pedigree traceability and metadata integrity across T0 to T2 progressive generations; executed mechanical processing, classification, and precise tracking of edited lineages to eliminate cross-contamination. • Molecular Validation: Conducted high-throughput genomic DNA extraction and executed qPCR molecular assays to support the screening and validation of homozygous, transgene-free stable lines.
